external_effects: none: the run changes simulated state only (no physical, institutional or networked effect)

registry.source_note: Primary texts were not available in the implementation environment; works are cited bibliographically and central claims are implementer paraphrases, unchecked against the texts.

sources.work: Tool-Being: Heidegger and the Metaphysics of Objects

entries.central_claim: Objects are never exhausted by their relations: their reality withdraws from every access, and objects affect one another only indirectly (vicariously), through sensual profiles.
entries.minimal_shape: a cluster whose boundary permeability is reduced (withdrawal) and whose interior becomes unobservable to other operations' instruments, plus one mediated connection (vicar)
configuration_conditions: a cluster with a boundary (region at the hierarchy's local level)
an instrument with the boundary_flow channel at the region's resolution
entries.ignition: observed flow across the region boundary (contact) above a threshold for `persist` samples
entries.rule: gate the region's boundary connections by `depth`; veil the region (opacity 1 − depth) for every instrument outside it; once per activation open one vicarious connection from the most active outside neighbour cluster to the region
entries.coupling: a veil is a change of everyone's observation conditions; any operation whose instrument loses its target behind the veil records `boundary_invisible`
entries.split: none (an object does not divide in this proxy)
entries.cessation: observed contact below half the threshold for `cease_after` samples, or the region's boundary can no longer be observed by its own instrument
entries.reignition: contact rises again, possibly under another configuration (e.g. after a veil elsewhere lifts)
entries.history_reinsertion: its veil history (when and where) is written to the external memory and can be re-inserted as a veil at a later step
entries.real_effects: runtime gates on boundary connections; new connections (vicars)
entries.approximation: 'withdrawal' is reduced to permeability and observability; real vs sensual qualities are reduced to true state vs instrument output. The ontological claim (inexhaustibility) has no counterpart that a simulation could exhibit.
entries.failure: the veil has no downstream effect (others' observations/ignitions unchanged) — the proxy then does nothing a plain gate does not do
entries.revision: if withdrawal is better modelled as a property of every relation rather than a regional operation, the proxy must be replaced (not tuned)

sources.work: L'individuation à la lumière des notions de forme et d'information (thesis 1958; complete ed. 2005; Eng. tr. 2020)
Du mode d'existence des objets techniques

entries.central_claim: Individuals result from the individuation of a metastable pre-individual field; transduction is the operation by which a structure propagates domain by domain, each structured region serving as the principle of structuring the next; the individual comes with an associated milieu.
entries.minimal_shape: a growing domain inside a metastable field: frontier clusters adjacent to the domain are structured (thresholds scaled) step by step; the rest of the parent cluster is the milieu
configuration_conditions: metastability: share of configurations near threshold (tension channel)
connections from the domain to its frontier
entries.ignition: observed tension in the milieu above a threshold while activity is present
entries.rule: structure up to `step_clusters` frontier clusters per act (threshold factor `factor`); the domain is the union of structured clusters
entries.coupling: a large individuated domain can be adopted as a system region by a closure operation, or plugged into an assemblage
entries.split: when the domain exceeds `split_size` configurations the operation divides into two, each with half of the domain (by address) and a perturbed factor
entries.cessation: tension in the milieu below half the threshold for `cease_after` samples (metastability exhausted); the structuring already done persists
entries.reignition: tension rebuilds, or an archived datum re-seeds a domain elsewhere
entries.history_reinsertion: reads archived data (if shared): a re-seed at the archived location
entries.real_effects: runtime threshold scaling over the domain
entries.approximation: metastability is reduced to closeness to an ignition threshold; information as 'disparation' and the pre-individual are not represented
entries.failure: domains grow regardless of tension (ignition condition not doing work) or never split
entries.revision: replace the frontier rule if propagation is better modelled as change of the milieu itself

entries.central_claim: The actual world is a process of actual occasions; each occasion concresces by prehending prior occasions into one satisfaction, then perishes and becomes a datum for later occasions (objective immortality).
entries.minimal_shape: an occasion collects observations of several clusters (prehensions) for `span` samples, integrates them into one datum (satisfaction), perishes, and deposits the datum in the external memory and as retained history (memory) in the most prehended clusters
configuration_conditions: an activity channel over several clusters (nexus)
entries.ignition: contrast: the spread of observed activity across the nexus above a threshold
entries.rule: after `span` samples: datum = weighted activity profile; deposit `alpha`·datum as memory into the top `deposit_clusters` clusters; archive the datum
entries.coupling: its archived data can be read by operations that share history (prehension by others)
entries.split: none; each occasion is new (the operation is a series of occasions)
entries.reignition: new contrast (creative advance) — or a re-inserted datum that restores contrast
entries.history_reinsertion: its deposits are history reinsertion by construction
entries.approximation: prehension is reduced to sampling observations; subjective form, eternal objects and God's role are absent
entries.failure: deposits never change later ignitions (data not re-entering)
entries.revision: replace the occasion/series model if occasions should overlap or nest

sources.work: Empiricism and the Philosophy of Mind
Philosophy and the Scientific Image of Man
Science and Metaphysics: Variations on Kantian Themes (ch. V)

entries.central_claim: Representational systems can picture the world as a matter of natural-order correspondence, distinct from semantic truth; pictures are improvable, and the scientific image can revise the categories of the manifest image.
entries.minimal_shape: a per-cluster predictive picture of observed activity, corrected by its error, revised (finer categories = finer instrument resolution) when error persists, and used to act (thresholds raised where overload is predicted)
configuration_conditions: optional: a symbol channel — only when the configuration flag `picturing_requires_symbol_channel` is set (language-like layer as an experimental condition, not a general requirement)
entries.rule: correct the picture (rate `rate`); after `revise_after` erroneous samples revise categories (instrument resolution one level finer, if any); raise thresholds by `damp` where predicted activity is high
entries.coupling: a revision propagates to operations that share its instrument (shared observation conditions)
entries.cessation: its channel unobservable for `cease_after` samples (it cannot picture what it cannot observe)
entries.reignition: the channel becomes observable again (e.g. a veil lifts, a channel is restored)
entries.history_reinsertion: reads archived data (if shared) as prior for the picture
entries.real_effects: runtime threshold scaling where overload is predicted
entries.approximation: picturing is reduced to predictive tracking; its normative/semantic distinction and the manifest/scientific images are reduced to resolution levels. Prediction error is NOT a measure of the doctrine's adequacy.
entries.failure: revision never reduces error, or acts are independent of the picture
entries.revision: replace if picturing should be second-order (pictures of picturing) or non-predictive

entries.series: Gilles Deleuze & Félix Guattari — Machinic Assemblages

sources.work: A Thousand Plateaus (Capitalism and Schizophrenia II)

entries.central_claim: Assemblages connect heterogeneous components through couplings of flows and cuts; they are stabilised (territorialised) and destabilised (deterritorialised) along lines of flight.
entries.minimal_shape: components in two or more macro clusters; territorialisation adds connections among them and opens their gates; when flow is observed blocked, a line of flight severs internal connections and connects to a further macro cluster
configuration_conditions: flows observable across macro clusters (boundary_flow at macro level)
entries.ignition: observed cross-cluster flow among its components above a threshold
entries.rule: territorialise: up to `links` new connections between components, gate ×`open`; deterritorialise when observed flow drops below `blocked`·previous: sever up to `links` internal connections, connect to the most active macro cluster not yet a component
entries.coupling: plugs into another operation whose region it reaches (composite kind)
entries.split: a composite it formed splits when co-activation stops
entries.history_reinsertion: none of its own; affected by re-inserted veils (blocked flows)
entries.approximation: desire, coding/decoding and the abstract machine are absent; flows are runtime penetrations
entries.failure: lines of flight never triggered by blocked flows, or couplings never change the coupled partner
entries.revision: replace if assemblage should be the field's default (everything an assemblage) rather than a series among others

sources.work: Die Gesellschaft der Gesellschaft (Theory of Society)

entries.central_claim: Systems reproduce their elements through their own operations (operational closure, autopoiesis); the environment does not instruct but only irritates them through structural couplings, and they draw their own system/environment distinction.
entries.minimal_shape: a cluster whose incoming boundary is closed except for a few coupling connections, which re-injects difference into itself when its own activity falls, and which changes its own thresholds when irritation accumulates
entries.ignition: observed share of region ignitions caused by internal connections above `recursion`
entries.rule: close incoming boundary (gate `closure`) except the `coupling` strongest observed channels; veil the region; re-inject `reproduce` when internal activity < `low`; on irritation > `irritation`, scale own thresholds by `adapt` (self-adjustment)
entries.coupling: its veil changes others' observations; actions of other operations into its region are filtered to its coupling connections (others' execution rules change); it can adopt an individuated domain as its system
entries.cessation: autopoiesis fails: internal activity zero for `cease_after` samples (closure is dissolved)
entries.approximation: communication/meaning and the system's own observation of its distinction are reduced to connection recursion and gates
entries.failure: closure never filters others' acts, or irritation never triggers self-adjustment
entries.revision: replace if closure must be defined by operation type rather than by region
